domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite unlike fractions as equivalent fractions before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD or other common denominator for unlike fractional parts.
Tag when fractions are converted to equivalent fractions with a shared denominator before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same.
Do not tag when a number is only rewritten into a subtraction-ready form without creating a common denominator.
Do not tag final simplification of the result.

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number, mixed number, or fraction into an equivalent subtraction-ready form without changing its value.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus a zero fraction.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when a fractional part is simplified before subtraction to match the operand structure.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for equivalent-fraction conversion whose purpose is to create a common denominator.
Do not tag for borrowing or regrouping that takes 1 from a whole part.
Do not tag for final simplification or final answer formatting.

skills.name: Subtract like fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already share a denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator, including fractional parts of mixed numbers once aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts fractions with the same denominator directly.
Tag when the fractional parts of mixed numbers are subtracted after denominators have been matched or after borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag whole-number subtraction by itself.
Do not tag the step of finding a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping itself.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of mixed numbers or whole numbers once the operands are in subtraction-ready form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly subtracts whole parts such as 4 − 2.
Tag when a whole-number minuend or subtrahend is treated as the whole part in a mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction of fractional numerators.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping that adjusts the whole part after an insufficient fractional part is detected.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fractional results.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 is taken from the whole part and converted into denominator-over-denominator fractional units.
Tag when borrowing is used after an initial negative fractional difference or anticipated fractional shortfall.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag normalization steps that only rewrite forms without taking 1 from the whole part.
Do not tag final combination of already computed parts.

skills.name: Finalize result
skills.definition: Express the subtraction result in correct final form by simplifying to lowest terms when needed and combining whole and fractional parts when applicable.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced to lowest terms or 0 over a denominator is rewritten as 0.
Tag when separate whole and fractional results are combined into a final mixed number, fraction, whole number, or zero.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted or a zero fractional part is absorbed into a whole number in the final answer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction steps before the result form is finalized.
Do not tag rewriting done solely to prepare operands for subtraction.
Do not tag simplification of an operand before subtraction.
